signal: Bending Spoons agreed to buy Mailchimp from Intuit for about $3.7B.
why_icp: A new owner usually changes pricing and product quickly. A huge small business user base will say exactly how they feel in tickets, reviews and cancel surveys.
suggested_contact_title: Head of Product or VP Customer Experience
first_line: Saw the Bending Spoons news. The next few months of Mailchimp feedback will show exactly which changes land and which ones drive churn.

signal: Raised $46M to take its smart TV OS international; now 30 million users, up from 18 million last year.
why_icp: Users nearly doubled in a year and new countries are next. TV OS feedback comes from manufacturers, app partners and viewers at once, which is the messy multi-source problem Enterpret is built for.
suggested_contact_title: VP Product or Head of Customer Insights
first_line: Going from 18 million to 30 million users in a year is a lot of new feedback to sort, especially with new countries coming.

signal: Hit a $3B valuation; says it has 7,000 LangSmith customers, from Harvey and Clay to Nvidia and Toyota.
why_icp: Open source community, GitHub issues, support tickets and enterprise accounts all at once. Tying feedback to the accounts that pay is the hard part.
suggested_contact_title: Head of Product or Head of Developer Experience
first_line: 7,000 LangSmith customers plus the open source community is a lot of feedback channels to keep straight.

signal: Doubled its valuation to $30B within six months; says run-rate revenue doubled to $400M in five months.
why_icp: Revenue doubling that fast means a lot of new enterprise customers asking for things at the same time. Product has to know which asks matter most.
suggested_contact_title: Head of Product Operations or VP Customer Experience
first_line: Doubling run-rate revenue to $400M in five months means a long list of customer asks. Curious how product decides which ones come first.

signal: Raised $90M led by Andreessen Horowitz; has processed more than 1 billion messages for DoorDash and hundreds of others.
why_icp: Developer platform growing into enterprises, with new products just launched. Feedback from builders and their end customers both lands on product.
suggested_contact_title: Head of Product or Head of Customer Success
first_line: Congrats on the $90M. With new products out and DoorDash on the platform, the feedback queue must be growing fast.

signal: Raised $280M at a $2B valuation to bring finance teams AI-native products.
why_icp: A big raise aimed at new AI products means a lot of launches next year. Knowing what finance teams actually complain about decides which ones win.
suggested_contact_title: VP Product or Head of Customer Experience
first_line: Congrats on the $280M. With new AI products coming, the customer feedback you already have is probably the best roadmap input.

signal: Freshworks alums raised $53M for an AI-native CRM; signed 100+ customers across 13 countries in three months.
why_icp: Young product, fast customer growth, and customers switching from Salesforce and HubSpot. Every switcher tells you what they expected and did not get.
first_line: 100 customers across 13 countries in three months is fast. The ones switching from Salesforce probably have a lot to say.

signal: Raised $250M a year after its $75M Series A, for AI agents built for bankers and consultants.
why_icp: Demanding users at banks and consulting firms, and a lot of new money to build with. Clear feedback from power users is worth a lot here.
suggested_contact_title: Head of Product or Head of Customer Success
first_line: Congrats on the $250M. Bankers are not shy about feedback, so organizing it well is probably a real edge.

signal: Raised a $20M seed; plans to grow engineering, design and growth marketing.
why_icp: Consumer investing app from the Anchor co-founder, about to scale up. Earlier than most Enterpret customers, but feedback habits set now tend to stick.
first_line: Congrats on the $20M seed. Getting user feedback organized before the growth push is a lot easier than after.
